stories.title: Two paths, one flux: Trapped ions simulate Aharonov–Bohm interference in a lattice gauge theory
stories.desc: In a new Nature Physics study, researchers demonstrated the Aharonov-Bohm effect in a quantum simulation of a lattice gauge theory using a hybrid trapped-ion quantum computer.

stories.title: Air holes turn silicon wafers into flat ultraviolet focusing mirrors for compact optics
stories.desc: Traditional lenses and mirrors focus light using curved surfaces. Metasurfaces can achieve similar functions with a flat layer of nanoscale structures that locally control the phase of light. stories.title: Quantum gas microscope reveals individual atoms in first tunable three-component Hubbard system
stories.desc: For the first time, an international team of researchers from Germany, Thailand, India, China and the United States has created a three-component Hubbard system with tunable interactions in the laboratory.
